parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by checking if all dimensions in a function are dimensionless and returns a dimensionless dimension if true. The change is minimal and does not introduce any apparent regressions.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding a comment explaining the logic for handling functions with dimensionless arguments.
